title: The settings of a part only some of them have can still be reached
goal: Pick five layers where three have a shadow. The Shadow row says Mixed, but there is no way to open it and change those three shadows: the only move on offer is giving all five one. Opening a part that only some of the picked layers have should show its settings, speaking for the ones that have it.
notes: PartsInspector.PartRowView: opens = isOn && row.hasSettings, so a mixed row hides its chevron. The old Shadow section did this already: ShadowInspector draws its sliders for selection.shadows, the subset that has one. The parts list threw that away when the switch moved up onto the row. Found while doing a-switch-says-mixed-the-way-every-other-control (audit 2026-09-06-switch-says-mixed, rough 3).
acceptance: A part row that says Mixed can be unfolded like any other row
Its settings change only the picked layers that have that part, in one undo step
The line under the row still says how many it reaches
A part no picked layer has still shows nothing to unfold
